etsy_taxonomy_path: Home & Living > Home Décor > Clocks > Wall Clocks
category_description: Wall Clock kategorisi duvar saatleri içerir. Decorative clocks, functional timepieces, modern, vintage, rustic styles dahildir.

focus_areas: Saat mekanizması görünürlüğü (akrep, yelkovan, saniye ibreleri)
Şekil ve form (yuvarlak, kare, oval, custom shape)
Stil belirleyicileri (vintage akrep-yelkovan, modern minimal, rustic wood)
Clock face depth (düz mı, 3D mi, raised numbers)

common_styles: Modern/Contemporary - minimal rakamlar, clean lines, metal/akrilik
Rustic/Farmhouse - distressed wood, vintage hands, natural materials
Vintage/Retro - klasik tasarım, nostaljik renkler, ornate details
Industrial - metal gears, exposed mechanism, raw finish
Scandinavian - minimal, light wood, simple numbers
Mid-Century Modern - geometric shapes, bold colors, atomic era
Coastal/Nautical - mavi-beyaz, deniz temaları, rope details

visual_clues: Wall mockup varsa duvar ile karşılaştırma
Eller ile tutuluyorsa el boyutuna göre tahmin
Clock mechanism boyutu (standart AA pil mekanizmaları ~6-8cm)
common_sizes: Medium: 12-18 inches (30-45cm) - en popüler, çoğu duvar
Large: 18-24 inches (45-60cm) - feature walls, büyük odalar

title_templates: Personalized [Material] Wall Clock | Custom [Theme] Clock | [Style] Home Decor

examples.modern_minimal: Modern Metal Wall Clock | Minimalist Silent Clock | Large Kitchen Timepiece

best_practices_category: Boyut bilgisi kritik - inch cinsinden belirt (12 inch, 18 inch)
Silent/Quiet keyword yüksek arama - sessiz mekanizma vurgusu
Large keyword popüler - büyük saatler trend
Room name (living room, kitchen) spesifik arama için

hook_templates: Make a statement in your [room] with this [size] [style] wall clock that combines functionality with [aesthetic quality].
This handcrafted [material] clock brings [emotional benefit] to your space while keeping you on time in style.
Looking for a unique [occasion] gift? This personalized wall clock is both practical and beautiful, perfect for [use case].
key_selling_points_to_highlight: Silent/Quiet mechanism (en önemli feature - özellikle bedroom için)

measurements_section.importance: Saatlerde boyut çok kritik - müşteri korkusu
include: Size comparison in photos ('Photo #X shows scale')
measurements_section.size_guidance: Duvar boyutuna göre öneriler - küçük duvar için 12-16", orta duvar için 16-20", büyük feature wall için 20-30"

essential_info: Silent/non-ticking özelliği (varsa vurgula - MAJOR selling point)
Pil tipi ve sayısı (1x AA battery)
Pil dahil mi değil mi (usually not included - belirt)
mechanism_details_section.if_silent_mechanism: NON-TICKING SILENT MECHANISM - Perfect for bedrooms, offices, and quiet spaces. Enjoy peaceful sleep without distracting tick-tock sounds.

include: Recommended wall stud for heavy clocks
Time setting instructions (simple - just turn hands)

care_instructions_specific: Wipe with soft, dry cloth - no harsh chemicals
Keep away from moisture (not bathroom suitable)
Replace battery when time slows (typically 12+ months)
Clean clock face gently with microfiber cloth
Do not use glass cleaner if wood

suggestions: Living Room - statement piece above sofa or fireplace
Kitchen - functional and decorative, easy to see while cooking
Bedroom - silent mechanism essential, soothing design

tags_generation_category_specific.strategy_notes: Silent/quiet tags yüksek conversion - mekanizma sessizse mutlaka kullan. Large/oversized popüler search terms. Material + style kombinasyonları güçlü (rustic wood clock).

Primary Color.analyze_from_image: Clock face veya frame dominant rengi

Room.guidance: Silent ise bedroom uygun, bold design ise living room

common_mistakes_to_avoid: Belirsiz boyut bilgisi - en büyük friction point

trend_awareness_2025: Silent mechanism artık beklenti - zorunlu özellik haline geldi
Minimal designs (rakamsız veya sadece index) artışta
Natural wood finishes (stained, raw) yüksek talep
Mixed materials (wood + metal) modern farmhouse için trend
Personalized family clocks (name, established date) hediye kategorisinde güçlü
